body:
The Niriin Estate is a named estate in Fein Uaill. Its presence in the regional directory and the illustration establish it as a distinct location, but the current archive does not yet identify its founder, present occupants, legal status, or relationship to the wider Niriin family.

What the archive can support

The Codex treats the estate’s name, regional placement, and visual identity as observed evidence. A shared surname alone is not enough to assign ownership, inheritance, or residence to Magnus Niriin.

The open record

The estate’s age, household, grounds, staff, political importance, and history remain unrecovered. Those questions stay attached to this page for later scene or source evidence.
